svg.title: Helix Hold arena candidates: measured concept geometry
svg.desc: Three candidate route plans shown from above and from the side. These are source-generated design studies, not playable arenas.
svg.text: Helix Hold · space to build a defense
Three measured route studies · proposed geometry only · no gameplay or balance claim
Same flight envelope: radius 52m, height 1.6–44m. All routes terminate at the existing core.
Local pairs reward shared chords; distant sectors reward dedicated lines.
Build the west pair first. Open east in two stages; preserve time to fly and reposition.
ALTERNATIVE · 3 GATES · TALL COIL + LOW BYPASS
A high central pair and a wide low route pull the fleet in different directions.
Strongest vertical test. The bypass introduces a new approach instead of another central coil.
Long diagonal approaches briefly share space, then separate into opposing exits.
Strongest change of shape. A plan crossing is only useful if its heights also align.
Colored circles = gates · white diamond = core · grid = 10m · all panels use the same scale
Projection hides depth: consult both views. Geometry fit does not establish readability, difficulty, reachable firing lines or a playable opening.
